in_marathi.name: Shila
in_marathi.long_meaning: Shila हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'shila' which means 'pebble' or 'rock'. This name represents calmness, stability, and peace. It is believed that those named Shila are grounded and strong, much like a rock.
